When one develops the path to rebirth in the fine-material realm, internally non-percipient of form, externally seeing limited forms, overcoming them, one knows and sees thus, quite secluded from sense pleasures... one enters and abides in the first jhāna with painful practice, slow direct knowledge, limited scope, and a limited object. At that time, contact arises... non-distraction arises... these states are wholesome.

manual_matches.content: The compilation of material phenomena is twofold –
manual_matches.source_content:
The compilation of material phenomena is twofold –
There is matter that is grasped; there is matter that is not grasped.
There is matter that is kammically acquired; there is matter that is not kammically acquired.
There is matter that is kammically acquired and an object of clinging; there is matter that is not kammically acquired and not an object of clinging.
There is matter that is visible; there is matter that is invisible.
There is matter with impact; there is matter without impact.
There is matter that is a faculty; there is matter that is not a faculty.
There is matter that is a great element; there is matter that is not a great element.
There is communicative matter, there is non-communicative matter.
There is mind-originated matter, there is not mind-originated matter.
There is matter conascent with mind, there is matter not conascent with mind.
There is matter following the mind, there is matter not following the mind.
There is internal matter, there is external matter.
There is gross matter, there is subtle matter.
There is far matter, there is near matter.
There is matter that is a base for eye-contact, there is matter that is not a base for eye-contact. There is matter that is a base for feeling born of eye-contact, for perception, for volition, for eye-consciousness; there is matter that is not a base for eye-consciousness.
There is matter that is a base for ear-contact, for nose-contact, for tongue-contact, for body-contact; there is matter that is not a base for body-contact. There is matter that is a base for feeling born of body-contact, for perception, for volition, for body-consciousness; there is matter that is not a base for body-consciousness.
There is matter that is an object for eye-contact, there is matter that is not an object for eye-contact. There is matter that is an object for feeling born of eye-contact, for perception, for volition, for eye-consciousness; there is matter that is not an object for eye-consciousness.
There is material form which is an object of ear-contact, and so on, up to body-contact; there is material form which is not an object of body-contact. There is material form which is an object of feeling arisen from body-contact, and so on, up to body-consciousness; there is material form which is not an object of body-consciousness.
There is material form which is the eye-base, and there is material form which is not the eye-base. There is material form which is the ear-base, and so on, up to the body-base; there is material form which is not the body-base.
There is material form which is the visible-form-base, and there is material form which is not the visible-form-base. There is material form which is the sound-base, and so on, up to the tangible-base; there is material form which is not the tangible-base.
There is material form which is the eye-element, and there is material form which is not the eye-element. There is material form which is the ear-element, and so on, up to the body-element; there is material form which is not the body-element.
There is material form which is the visible-form-element, and there is material form which is not the visible-form-element. There is material form which is the sound-element, and so on, up to the tangible-element; there is material form which is not the tangible-element.
There is material form which is the eye-faculty, and there is material form which is not the eye-faculty. There is material form which is the ear-faculty, and so on, up to the body-faculty; there is material form which is not the body-faculty.
There is material form which is the femininity faculty, and there is material form which is not the femininity faculty.
There is material form which is the masculinity faculty, and there is material form which is not the masculinity faculty.
There is material form which is the life faculty, and there is material form which is not the life faculty.
There is material form which is bodily intimation, and there is material form which is not bodily intimation.
There is form that is vocal intimation, there is form that is not vocal intimation.
There is form that is the space element, there is form that is not the space element.
There is form that is the water element, there is form that is not the water element.
There is form that is the lightness of form, there is form that is not the lightness of form.
There is form that is the malleability of form, there is form that is not the malleability of form.
There is form that is the wieldiness of form, there is form that is not the wieldiness of form.
There is form that is the production of form, there is form that is not the production of form.
There is form that is the continuity of form, there is form that is not the continuity of form.
There is form that is the decay of form, there is form that is not the decay of form.
There is form that is the impermanence of form, there is form that is not the impermanence of form.
There is material phenomenon that is edible food, there is material phenomenon that is not edible food.
Thus, the collection of material phenomena is twofold.
Duality.

That material phenomenon which is internal, that is clung to. That material phenomenon which is external, that is sometimes clung to, sometimes not clung to.

That material phenomenon which is internal, that is impinging. That material phenomenon which is external, that is sometimes impinging, sometimes non-impinging.
That material phenomenon which is internal, that is a faculty. That material phenomenon which is external, that is sometimes a faculty, sometimes not a faculty.

That material phenomenon which is internal, that is not mind-originated. That material phenomenon which is external, that is sometimes mind-originated, sometimes not mind-originated.

content: Which states are wholesome? When, for rebirth in the fine-material realm, one cultivates the path, having ceased initial and sustained application..., and enters and abides in the second jhāna... third jhāna... fourth jhāna... first jhāna... fifth jhāna, with practice with difficulty and slow comprehension, by means of the earth kasiṇa..., and similarly for the other three modes of practice; at that time, there is contact... and non-distraction... these are wholesome states.⤵

When one develops the path to rebirth in the fine-material realm, internally non-percipient of form, externally seeing limited forms, overcoming them, one knows and sees thus, with the cessation of initial and sustained application... one enters and abides in the second jhāna... third jhāna... fourth jhāna... first jhāna... fifth jhāna, with painful practice, slow direct knowledge, limited scope, and a limited object... and so on, up to with pleasant practice, swift direct knowledge, immeasurable scope, and a limited object. At that time, contact arises... non-distraction arises... these states are wholesome.
Eightfold combination.

content: Which are the wholesome states? When, cultivating the path to rebirth in the fine-material sphere, internally perceiving non-form, externally seeing limited forms, beautiful or ugly, overcoming them with the thought 'I know, I see!', with the cessation of initial and sustained application... enters and abides in the second jhána... third jhána... fourth jhána... first jhána... fifth jhána; at that time, contact arises... non-distraction arises... these states are wholesome.
This also is the eightfold combination.

content: In this connection, what is all form?⤵The four great primary elements, and form derived from the four great primary elements—this is called all form. All form is not a root, rootless, dissociated from roots, with conditions, conditioned, form, mundane, with taints, binding, fettering, deluging, yoking, obstructing, grasped, clung to, defiling, indeterminate, without object, without mental factors, dissociated from consciousness, neither result nor result-producing, undefiled but defiling, not with initial and sustained application, not merely with sustained application, without initial and sustained application, not accompanied by zest, not accompanied by happiness, not accompanied by equanimity, not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development, not having roots to be abandoned by seeing nor by development, neither leading to accumulation nor diminution, neither trainee nor adept, limited, belonging to the sense-sphere, not fine-material, not immaterial, included, not unincluded, unfixed, not leading to liberation, arisen, knowable by the six consciousnesses, impermanent, overcome by decay.
Thus, the compendium of form in one way.
The Monads.

content: The compilation of material phenomena is twofold –
There is matter that is grasped; there is matter that is not grasped.
There is matter that is kammically acquired; there is matter that is not kammically acquired.
There is matter that is kammically acquired and an object of clinging; there is matter that is not kammically acquired and not an object of clinging.
There is matter that is visible; there is matter that is invisible.
There is matter with impact; there is matter without impact.
There is matter that is a faculty; there is matter that is not a faculty.
There is matter that is a great element; there is matter that is not a great element.
There is communicative matter, there is non-communicative matter.
There is mind-originated matter, there is not mind-originated matter.
There is matter conascent with mind, there is matter not conascent with mind.
There is matter following the mind, there is matter not following the mind.
There is internal matter, there is external matter.
There is gross matter, there is subtle matter.
There is far matter, there is near matter.

There is matter that is a base for eye-contact, there is matter that is not a base for eye-contact. There is matter that is a base for feeling born of eye-contact, for perception, for volition, for eye-consciousness; there is matter that is not a base for eye-consciousness.

There is matter that is a base for ear-contact, for nose-contact, for tongue-contact, for body-contact; there is matter that is not a base for body-contact. There is matter that is a base for feeling born of body-contact, for perception, for volition, for body-consciousness; there is matter that is not a base for body-consciousness.

There is matter that is an object for eye-contact, there is matter that is not an object for eye-contact. There is matter that is an object for feeling born of eye-contact, for perception, for volition, for eye-consciousness; there is matter that is not an object for eye-consciousness.

There is material form which is an object of ear-contact, and so on, up to body-contact; there is material form which is not an object of body-contact. There is material form which is an object of feeling arisen from body-contact, and so on, up to body-consciousness; there is material form which is not an object of body-consciousness.

There is material form which is the eye-base, and there is material form which is not the eye-base. There is material form which is the ear-base, and so on, up to the body-base; there is material form which is not the body-base.

There is material form which is the visible-form-base, and there is material form which is not the visible-form-base. There is material form which is the sound-base, and so on, up to the tangible-base; there is material form which is not the tangible-base.

There is material form which is the eye-element, and there is material form which is not the eye-element. There is material form which is the ear-element, and so on, up to the body-element; there is material form which is not the body-element.

There is material form which is the visible-form-element, and there is material form which is not the visible-form-element. There is material form which is the sound-element, and so on, up to the tangible-element; there is material form which is not the tangible-element.

There is material form which is the eye-faculty, and there is material form which is not the eye-faculty. There is material form which is the ear-faculty, and so on, up to the body-faculty; there is material form which is not the body-faculty.
There is material form which is the femininity faculty, and there is material form which is not the femininity faculty.
There is material form which is the masculinity faculty, and there is material form which is not the masculinity faculty.
There is material form which is the life faculty, and there is material form which is not the life faculty.
There is material form which is bodily intimation, and there is material form which is not bodily intimation.
There is form that is vocal intimation, there is form that is not vocal intimation.
There is form that is the space element, there is form that is not the space element.
There is form that is the water element, there is form that is not the water element.
There is form that is the lightness of form, there is form that is not the lightness of form.
There is form that is the malleability of form, there is form that is not the malleability of form.
There is form that is the wieldiness of form, there is form that is not the wieldiness of form.
There is form that is the production of form, there is form that is not the production of form.
There is form that is the continuity of form, there is form that is not the continuity of form.
There is form that is the decay of form, there is form that is not the decay of form.
There is form that is the impermanence of form, there is form that is not the impermanence of form.
There is material phenomenon that is edible food, there is material phenomenon that is not edible food.
Thus, the collection of material phenomena is twofold.
Duality.

Ignorance of suffering, its origin, its cessation, and the path to its cessation; ignorance of the past, of the future, of both, and of dependent arising in conditionally arisen phenomena; whatever such ignorance, non-seeing, non-comprehension, non-understanding, non-awakening, non-penetration, non-grasping, non-fathoming, non-reflection, non-reviewing, non-direct knowledge, dullness, folly, non-discernment, delusion, utter delusion, confusion, ignorance, flood of ignorance, bond of ignorance, latent disposition of ignorance, obsession of ignorance, chain of ignorance, delusion, root of unwholesome – this is called the canker of ignorance.
These states are cankers.

content: What is clinging to a doctrine of self? Here, an uninstructed worldling, not seeing noble ones, not skilled in the noble Dhamma, not trained in the noble Dhamma; not seeing true men, not skilled in the Dhamma of true men, not trained in the Dhamma of true men – perceives form as self, or self as possessing form, or form as being in self, or self as being in form. Feeling... perception... mental formations... consciousness he perceives as self, or self as possessing consciousness, or consciousness as being in self, or self as being in consciousness. Such a view, wrong view, thicket of views, wilderness of views, agitation of views, fickleness of views, fetter of views, grasp, holding, adherence, clinging, wrong path, false way, wrongness, heretical tenet, perverse grasp – this is called clinging to a doctrine of self.
These phenomena are clingings.

unmatched_source_segments.source_content: Homage to the Blessed One, the Arahant, the Perfectly Enlightened One.
1. Chapter on the Arising of Consciousness

What on that occasion is the power of energy?
That which on that occasion is mental energy, exertion, effort, striving, endeavor, enthusiasm, perseverance, strength, firmness, unflagging effort, unabandoned desire, unabandoned burden, undertaking the burden, energy, energy faculty, power of energy, right effort—this is the power of energy on that occasion.

What is that material form which is the tongue sense base?
The tongue, that is to say the sensitive matter, derived from the four great primaries, included in one's own being, invisible and with impingement; depending on which tongue, in consequence of taste, gustatory contact has arisen, arises, will arise, or may arise…pe… depending on which tongue, in consequence of taste, feeling born of gustatory contact…pe… perception…pe… volition…pe… gustatory consciousness has arisen, arises, will arise, or may arise…pe… depending on which tongue, having taste as its object, gustatory contact has arisen, arises, will arise, or may arise…pe… depending on which tongue, having taste as its object, feeling born of gustatory contact…pe… perception…pe… volition…pe… gustatory consciousness has arisen, arises, will arise, or may arise; this is the tongue, this is the tongue sense base, this is the tongue element, this is the tongue faculty, this is the world, this is the door, this is the ocean, this is the white, this is the field, this is the ground, this is the hither shore, this is the empty village – this is that material form which is the tongue sense base.
